| TunerStudio label | Setting | Units | Range | Help (as TunerStudio shows it) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Output | `gppwm4_pin` | choice |  | Select a pin to use for PWM or on-off output. https://rusefi.com/docs/pinouts/proteus/?highlight=class~outputs |
| Frequency | `gppwm4_pwmFrequency` | hz | 0 … 500 | Select a frequency to run PWM at. Set this to 0hz to enable on-off mode. |
| On above duty | `gppwm4_onAboveDuty` | % | 0 … 100 | Hysteresis: in on-off mode, turn the output on when the table value is above this duty. |
| Off below duty | `gppwm4_offBelowDuty` | % | 0 … 100 | Hysteresis: in on-off mode, turn the output off when the table value is below this duty. |
| Duty if error | `gppwm4_dutyIfError` | % | 0 … 100 | If an error (with a sensor, etc) is detected, this value is used instead of reading from the table. This should be a safe value for whatever hardware is connected to prevent damage. |
| X Axis | `gppwm4_rpmAxis` | choice |  | Selects the X axis to use for the table. |
| Y Axis | `gppwm4_loadAxis` | choice |  | Selects the Y axis to use for the table. |
